## Validation

- [ ] `bun run type-check`

- [ ] `bun run check:pi` (Pi host / protocol / broker / runtime)
- [ ] `bun run --cwd packages/web test` (web server or transport)
- [ ] `bun run docs:validate` (docs)
- [ ] `bun run dead-code` (added, deleted, or renamed exports)
